resolution.question: The two founders of the Tidepool app have been at odds over strategy since spring. Will they announce a buyout of one side to their twelve employees within the next three months?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the founders actually announced a buyout of one side to the twelve employees before 2026-11-01T10:00:00-07:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
